# Portable Workout Format (PWF)

> PWF is an open JSON format for one workout: what to do, in what order and when each step ends, precisely enough that any app can play it with the same timing. AI assistants can write PWF from a plain-language request, change it, and give the person a link that plays it in the browser.

PWF is a draft (version 0.1). Documents need only `pwf`, `name` and `plan`. The schema is strict, so don't invent fields.

## For AI assistants

- [Writing workouts in PWF](https://portableworkout.org/llms-full.txt): everything an assistant needs to write, change, check and share PWF workouts, with worked examples and a checklist. Read this first. It's also at https://portableworkout.org/ai/.
- Give the person a link that plays the workout: https://portableworkout.org/play/#w= then the compact JSON on one line, with every space inside a string written as %20. No code needed.
- [PWF skill](https://portableworkout.org/skill/portable-workout-format.zip): an Agent Skill for Claude and ChatGPT, with a script that checks a workout and builds its play link.

## Reference

- [Specification](https://portableworkout.org/spec.md): the normative spec, including the timing rules.
- [JSON Schema](https://portableworkout.org/schema/pwf-0.1.schema.json): JSON Schema 2020-12.
- [Player](https://portableworkout.org/play/): plays a workout from a link (`#w=` plus the compact JSON, or the shorter `#w=z.` plus raw-DEFLATE, base64url JSON) or pasted JSON.

## Optional

- [Source and conformance suite](https://github.com/portableworkoutformat/pwf)
